column1: # Phyre per-class instance size and alignment, read from the arguments of the class-descriptor
# constructor 00632D80 (4 of the 177 registrars call the near-identical 00632C90). Win64 mapping:
# arg4 = r9d -> descriptor +0x38; arg5 = the 5th slot, caller [rsp+0x20] -> descriptor +0x3C.
# CONTROL 1 (internal): every field the independently recovered phyre-field-schema.tsv places in a
#   class fits inside instance_size - 177 of 177, and 33 classes fit EXACTLY to the byte.
# CONTROL 2 (external): four classes are Microsoft-documented D3D11 structs whose layout is fixed
#   by the SDK headers and owes nothing to this image - size AND alignment match, 4 of 4.
# slack = instance_size - max_field_end; blank where the schema recovered no field for the class.
